summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing for PT SBB finance app. 19/19 pytest cases passed (auth, RBAC, documents, approvals, journal accounting balance, dashboard, tax settings, accounts). Frontend UI flow verified end-to-end: admin login -> dashboard -> create PP with DPP 10.000.000/PPN 11%/PPh23 2% -> approve all 4 steps -> generate journal -> Jurnal Umum page loaded & CSV export downloaded -> tax settings save -> accounts page -> users page (admin only) -> logout -> login as keuangan (Users menu correctly hidden).

ui_bugs.issue: Kartu 'Total Nilai Pengajuan' menampilkan value kosong (tidak ada angka Rp) meskipun backend /api/dashboard/summary mengembalikan field total_nilai. Kemungkinan frontend tidak render angka jika total 0/undefined atau class .value tidak diisi.

action_items: (Optional) Render Rupiah value pada kartu 'Total Nilai Pengajuan' pada Dashboard bila total_nilai tersedia dari /api/dashboard/summary.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: update_user memakai '$inc': {} bila body.password tidak diberikan; MongoDB tetap menerima empty $inc tapi kurang idiomatik - conditionally tambahkan operator.
Journal generation menggunakan tarif dari tax settings; PPh21 default 5% (bukan progresif) - sesuai deskripsi di seed, aman selama admin mengubahnya bila perlu.
Dev overlay preview environment menginjeksikan <span> di dalam <option> -> hydration warning; ini bukan bug aplikasi (tag x-excluded=true).
server.py (~750 LOC) dan seed_data.py dalam batas wajar; masih monolit -- pertimbangkan split modul auth, documents, journal ke file terpisah jika bertambah besar.
seed_data_creation: Backend seed on startup creates admin + demo keuangan user + DEFAULT_COA + DEFAULT_TAX_SETTINGS. UI test created documents prefixed TEST_ (PP,PPBJ,PUM) that persist in Mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers auth, RBAC, PP full workflow with balanced journal assertions (Debit Beban 10M + PPN 1.1M ; Kredit PPh23 200k + Kas 10.9M). Reuse for regression. Dashboard 'total nilai' card may be missing value formatting in UI - verify.
rca of the issue: N/A - fully working. Minor cosmetic issue only.
